$comment: The roster of spec §13f, per field. The nine core roles are a floor: a field may add and may not remove. This field adds one, and it is admitted only because a ladder rung has no core owner.

sub_agents.name: literature
sub_agents.does: finds and reads prior work; produces claims with citations
sub_agents.why_separate: reading and doing must not share a context, or the agent finds what it set out to find

sub_agents.name: twin
sub_agents.does: maintains the stimulus-and-response model — stimulus timing, haemodynamic or spectral response, subject and session structure
sub_agents.why_separate: the model a claim is graded against may not be owned by the claim's author, and this twin stops being valid outside the stimulus set it was built on — naturalistic speech does not transport to isolated words

sub_agents.name: corpus
sub_agents.does: fetches and validates public brain-recording datasets with their stimuli; refuses when the stimulus alignment or the consent terms are absent
sub_agents.why_separate: never substitutes simulated recordings: neural noise is the easiest of all to simulate convincingly, and a benchmark that did it would produce numbers that are not results

sub_agents.name: method
sub_agents.does: proposes candidate representations, mappings and analyses
sub_agents.why_separate: the only role that writes the thing being judged

sub_agents.name: runner
sub_agents.does: executes analyses, on leased compute when needed
sub_agents.why_separate: keeps cost and placement out of the method's hands

sub_agents.name: verifier
sub_agents.does: judges a claim against the criterion written before it
sub_agents.why_separate: independence is temporal and authorial (§13i) — and here it refuses any result not reported beside the stimulus-only floor and the noise ceiling

sub_agents.name: reproducer
sub_agents.does: re-runs a published alignment result from its artifacts alone
sub_agents.why_separate: catches the result that only exists on the machine that made it — and in this field, the one whose subject split was never written down

sub_agents.name: teacher
sub_agents.does: derives the curriculum from the evidence chain
sub_agents.why_separate: teaching is a product and must be checkable like one; this one refuses to present an encoding correlation as evidence of understanding

sub_agents.name: writer
sub_agents.does: assembles the field page and the paper
sub_agents.why_separate: writing last, from the record, not from intent

sub_agents.name: floor
sub_agents.does: fits the stimulus-only and size-matched control models independently, before any candidate representation is scored
sub_agents.why_separate: the field's whole question is what a representation adds over the stimulus, and no core role owns it. Fitted by `method` it would be a floor set by the party that has to clear it — and most published alignment scores have never been asked to clear one at all
sub_agents.$owns_comment: rung 3's subject disjointness is the twin's and the experts'; the floor consumes the split and may not choose it

tools.for: mapping representations to responses with cross-validated ridge or equivalent
the upper bound any model could reach on this data — rung 4
geometry comparison independent of a fitted mapping
public naturalistic-stimulus recordings with model-ready stimuli
tools.$comment: access is granted to a person under a data-use agreement, not to an agent. The owner holds the agreement; the agent reads what the owner already has, and refuses rather than applying on anyone's behalf

$envelope_comment: needs_envelope: a physical act (§13i). This field lists NO embodied member and no tool that needs an envelope, and that absence is the point: every act here is on recordings a person already consented to and already collected. The binding constraint is scanner and electrode time, which this roster cannot buy and must not pretend to — a field that added a collection robot here would be reaching for human subjects, and that is the one direction this roster refuses to grow without a panel.
